title: No Shortcuts
summary: Instant rule changes are refused once the Policy Guard guards the Safe. Asking for a change always works.
lesson: Once the Policy Guard is installed in either slot, rules change only through the waiting period. No rule, not even a catch-all that allows everything, can reach the guard itself.

rules.note: Allows every CALL without its own rule

steps.label: Change the rules instantly
steps.note: Only the module guard is installed, so nothing checks this owner transaction. The Policy Guard refuses it anyway, because it already guards the Safe.

steps.label: Install the transaction guard
steps.note: There is no transaction guard yet, so this runs unchecked.

steps.label: Try the instant change again
steps.note: Now the guard checks it first. The catch-all allows every call, but no rule can open the guard itself.

steps.label: Ask for the change instead
steps.note: Asking for, applying and cancelling changes are always allowed, with no rule needed. The change itself still has to wait.
